online_exams.create:
CREATE TABLE `online_exams` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `school_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `subject_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `exam_type` enum('cat','midterm','final','quiz','assignment') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cat',
  `start_datetime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_datetime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration_mins` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
  `total_marks` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  `pass_mark` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
  `max_attempts` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `shuffle_questions` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `shuffle_options` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `allow_previous_navigation` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `result_release_policy` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'immediate',
  `webcam_required` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `fullscreen_required` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `instructions` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `workflow_state` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `is_published` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `auto_submit` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `creator_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `updater_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancellation_reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `online_exams_school_id_index` (`school_id`),
  KEY `online_exams_workflow_state_index` (`workflow_state`),
  KEY `online_exams_creator_id_index` (`creator_id`),
  KEY `online_exams_updater_id_index` (`updater_id`),
  KEY `online_exams_reviewed_by_index` (`reviewed_by`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
